title: Combining low-cost single board computers with open-source software for gas extraction
author: Twinn

steps.title: Prepare sample and vacuum system
steps.instruction: Place each mineral grain into a 0.5 mm‑diameter high‑purity platinum tube, load the tubes into the copper planchet containing 55 sample pits, seal the planchet with a copper gasket, position the planchet in the laser cell and pump the whole system down to 1 × 10⁻⁸ mbar overnight.

steps.title: Position laser and start run
steps.instruction: Using the joystick, move the laser assembly above the selected sample while monitoring with the camera, enter the sample identifier into the computer, and press the run button.

steps.title: Set initial valve configuration
steps.instruction: Software opens valves 6 and 7, and closes valves 8, 13 and 10.

steps.title: Activate laser for heating
steps.instruction: After valve 10 is closed, click the button to enable the LaserVall 1PERACKF21 Nd:YAG 808/1064 nm laser and start a timer to deactivate it after 3 minutes.

steps.title: Purge sections A and B
steps.instruction: Software opens valve 8 to allow the ion pump to purge sections A and B for 2 minutes, then closes valve 8.

steps.title: Add 3He spike
steps.instruction: Open valve 4 to fill the calibrated pipette (volume 0.2258 cc ± 0.0012 cc; spike concentration 100–1000 × sample 4He) with 3He; close valve 4 a few seconds later.

steps.title: Transfer gases to section B
steps.instruction: Open valves 3 and 10 to allow the 3He spike and the outgassed 4He to expand into section B.

steps.title: Move gas from B to A
steps.instruction: After 1 minute, close valve 6 to shut off the ion pump and open valve 8 to let the gas from section B flow into section A.

steps.title: Acquire mass‑spectrometer data
steps.instruction: Software records 20 readings from the Pfeiffer QMS 400 mass spectrometer at 9‑second intervals, saving the data with the sample reference.

steps.title: Calculate 4He/3He ratio
steps.instruction: A Java application computes the 4He/3He ratio for each data point, performs regression to obtain the initial ratio, and the researcher notes this value.

steps.title: Final purge after measurement
steps.instruction: Software opens valve 6 to purge the laser chamber and sections A and B via the ion pump; continue purging for 8 minutes, then end the analytical routine.

steps.title: Evaluate ratio and decide on re‑heating
steps.instruction: If the measured 4He/3He ratio > 2.0, repeat the entire process to re‑heat the sample; if the ratio < 1.0, assume the platinum tube was empty.

steps.title: Proceed to next sample
steps.instruction: Move the laser to the next sample pit and repeat steps 2–11.

steps.title: Daily start‑up blank and standard
steps.instruction: Run a line blank (same procedure with the laser disabled) and a Q‑Standard (same procedure using a known 4He amount from a pipette) at the beginning of each day to verify line performance.

steps.title: Daily end‑of‑day blank and standard
steps.instruction: At the end of the day, run another line blank and Q‑Standard to confirm the line is still operating correctly.
